## Jim Beam (G4)

“Jim Beam” is the fandom name for the golden-tan Earth-pony construction worker rescued by Rainbow Dash in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*, “The Mysterious Mare Do Well” (S2E8). He is the panicked stallion yelling directions as Rainbow dodges a collapsing building. Pinkie Pie, disguised as the Mysterious Mare Do Well, saves his coworkers; Jim himself is **not** a disguised hero.

[![Jim Beam, a tan Earth-pony stallion in a show still from S2E8](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/5/51/Jim_Beam_ID_S2E08.png/revision/latest?cb=20120227215229)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/File:Jim_Beam_ID_S2E08.png)

*Show capture: Hasbro/DHX Media, via the My Little Pony Friendship is Magic Wiki’s episode-image archive.*

**Appearance and name.** Golden-tan coat, light reddish-brown mane and tail, dark blue eyes, and a steel **I-beam cutie mark**. The [Earth-pony stallion catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions) uses “Jim Beam” as an unofficial community identifier; the name is apparently an I-beam pun, not an established on-screen or Hasbro name. He shares a color scheme with another worker nicknamed “Rivet,” but they are distinct ponies. The originator and date of the nickname are unverified.

**Speaking and appearances.** **He speaks** in S2E8, urgently warning Rainbow about falling debris and telling her to go to her “other left,” then faints after being set down safely. The [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Mysterious_Mare_Do_Well) identifies those lines with the fandom name. A character-specific English voice-actor credit could not be confirmed. No other appearance or alternate identity was reliably established.

## Important moments

- **Construction-site disaster — “The Mysterious Mare Do Well” (S2E8).** A crane accident starts a collapse; Rainbow Dash swoops in to rescue Jim while Mare Do Well saves the other endangered workers. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R6C0FptWzLw) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **“Your other left!” — “The Mysterious Mare Do Well” (S2E8).** Jim’s frantic warnings and subsequent faint make Rainbow’s hazardous, imperfect rescue memorable, just before the other workers praise Mare Do Well’s broader rescue.
